name: Ozark Biomedical
old_description: I would like you to know that I’ve been doing business with Ozark Biomedical since 2007 and I am very impressed with the work the techs perform on the centrifuge PC boards and motors.
about:
Ozark Biomedical operates from Beebe, Arkansas, where it was founded in 2007. The company remains privately held, though ownership details such as family or veteran status are not publicly disclosed. It began as a specialty provider of centrifuge parts and repair services for laboratory and clinical settings.

The company supplies replacement parts and performs repairs for a wide range of centrifuge models from manufacturers including Beckman, Thermo Fisher, Eppendorf, Hettich, and others. Its core manufacturing activity is the remanufacture of motors, latches, and circuit boards to meet or exceed original OEM specifications. Ozark Biomedical also offers products on an exchange basis, requiring return of a repairable core, and provides recertified and remanufactured centrifuges with limited parts warranties.

Customers span pharmaceutical research, clinical laboratories, and hospital facilities. A noted client is Novum Pharmaceutical Research Services. The company’s brand portfolio covers virtually all major centrifuge lines used in diagnostics, blood banking, and life-science research.

Ozark Biomedical emphasizes its exchange program as a cost-saving alternative to new purchases and highlights extended warranty options with on-site service. Customer testimonials cite responsive support and a personalized service approach.
